newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Group says no plans to outsource IT.
newsitem.headline: CS Group says no plans to outsource IT.

text.p: CS Group has reorganised its information technology activities but does not plan to outsource the entire area, new chief executive Lukas Muehlemann said in a newspaper interview on Wednesday.

Muehlemann told the Basler Zeitung a decentralised structure had recently been introduced, which may have been the cause of stock market rumours that the banking group would turn to a third party for all its computer and information needs.
"There will be no outsourcing of the entire information technology side," Muehlemann told the paper.
